text:
Lina: HelixWell requested a short-term QPS bump + enable ap-northeast-1 for their pilot next week. They also want an IP allowlist for CI runners and the onboarding PM mentioned renewal could slip to 'at-risk' if the pilot has issues. Need network + infra signoff.

Raj: What's their tenant and current sustained qps?

Lina: tenant: helixwell-prod-7, current sustained ~85 qps, asking to allow bursts up to 300 qps for 48h around the pilot. Renewal in ~30 days. Health: yellow due to slow docs and two unresolved onboarding bugs.

Elliot: We can open ap-northeast-1 routing and a 48h multiplier. Need CIDRs and whether they want only egress or full bi-directional.

Lina: CIDRs: 192.0.2.0/25 (CI runners), 198.51.100.0/28 (on-prem test harness). They only need outbound whitelisting to our edge.

Raj: Runbook to apply (net/ops):
```bash
# apply allowlist + region + temp qps
redwoodctl tenants update helixwell-prod-7 \
  --allowlist 192.0.2.0/25,198.51.100.0/28 \
  --regions-add ap-northeast-1 \
  --rate-override duration=48h,multiplier=3x
```

Elliot: I'll check capacity on pool-ded-8 (apac) and reserve a burst node if needed. Tag: helixwell-pilot-burst. ETA ~90m if we need to spin.

OpsBot: job queued: allowlist-3712349999. Will post progress.

Yvonne: PM asked we enable enhanced tracing during the pilot and record 95/99 latency bins. Also ask customer to run smoke tests 30 mins before demo start.

Lina: Confirmed pilot window: 2026-04-02 09:00 JST. They want zero throttling during first 30 mins.

Raj: We'll set fallback to eu-west-1 if ap-northeast latency exceeds 220ms or error rate >0.8%. Rollback policy: automatic after 48h if no renewal uplift.

Elliot: Starting capacity check now. If capacity insufficient, I'll provision a single g4dn-style burst with the right runtime.

OpsBot: allowlist-3712349999 started at 3712341010, status: in_progress.

Lina: Please DM me any 5xx spikes during the pilot. I'll update CRM to mark renewal as 'watch' and note follow-up actions.

OpsBot: allowlist-3712349999 completed at 3712350405, status: success.

Elliot: ap-northeast-1 routing is live. Initial smoke run shows 95th latency ~120ms, no 5xx. Burst node reserved but not used.

Raj: Sending checklist to HelixWell PM:
- Add IPs to allowlist
- Run smoke test vs ap-northeast-1
- Expect slight cold-starts for first requests
- File any errors to #support immediately

Yvonne: I'll collect pilot feedback and an NPS pulse 48h after the pilot. Lina, can you escalate renewal cadence if the pilot is green?

Lina: Yes. I'll schedule a renewal touchpoint 1 week after pilot and capture notes in CRM. Closing thread unless issues come up during the pilot.
